invariants.rationale: The method requires the config parameter to execute its logic and calls methods on it, so it must not be null.
The static type of config is HoodieWriteConfig, so it must be an instance of HoodieWriteConfig.
The method switches on config.getIndexType(), so it should not be null to avoid NullPointerException.
The first conditional checks for this; before returning, createIndex will use this check.
